node.title: XR rank-five residual is a divided-difference monochromatic-clique census
node.statement: In the retained P-A RowC rank-five u=v=0 core, every selected agreement set A has nonzero fourth divided difference [S]q on each five-subset S. Indeed, a zero would make all five constituent four-sets unreusable, while the r=2 peeling core permits at most 1/3/4 unreused four-sets on the three rows. Therefore Phi(S)=[S]U/[S]q is defined throughout A and is identically the selected slope gamma. Distinct members are distinct-color monochromatic (4+h)-cliques, and the preceding ratio fibers and zero minors are exactly equal-color four-stars of Phi. This is an exact bridge to the split-pencil census, not a clique count.
